QuestInfo.name: A Great Honor
QuestInfo.0: You were requested to assume the role of Commander of the #bDawn Warriors#k, the warrior unit of the Cygnus Knights.
QuestInfo.1:
Although you already serve as the Knight of Light, the guardian of the Empress, this is #ewhat Her Highness requested#n, so you decide to follow orders.

Go to the Empress to claim your new title.
QuestInfo.2: Following the order of the Empress, I accept my charge as Commander of the Dawn Warrior.
